interpretation: Henderson-Hasselbalch, Faraday and mass fractions have explicit BW source mentions despite missing current BW applicability on their particular card-origin goals. Therefore absence of a canonical BW entry is a binding gap, not proof of curricular exclusion.
The BW source orbital-model sentence does not by itself establish the full sodium-doublet/quantum-number origin goal. A specific source-to-origin binding has not been authored or approved here.

No explicit IR/NMR or quantitative Arrhenius equation claim was located in the finite BW source text examined. This bounded author task does not infer broad state-wide course additions from a national memory-node applicability list.

All four current memory nodes carry GK and LK tags. Each of the 45 cards matches those tags, so the current frontend/backend tag filter admits the entire deck, including the nine cards whose present origin-goal applicability lacks BW. Neither filter is supplied the current composition target goal set.
Deck ownership is canonical DE/Gymnasium; retained BY provenance is not a licence to rename, clone or silently expose a second curriculum. No card, goal, applicability or curriculum tag was changed.
The rejected diagnostic uses explicit target for each added memory goal. prerequisiteOnly would hide the node from the production memory visibility collector and is not a remedy.
